title: drydocs.data-centers.v1 — the data-center spelling registry (LOAD2)
description: One row per data center, carrying BOTH spellings: the short Control-M server code (CM_DEF_VTAB.DATA_CENTER) and the long-form name (CM_HOSTS / CM_AVG_RUN). The pairing is declared because short -> long is not derivable: the long form carries a default-time segment and a suffix the short code does not contain.

updated.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

code.description: SHORT Control-M server code — what CM_DEF_VTAB.DATA_CENTER carries.

name.description: LONG-form data-center name — what CM_HOSTS and CM_AVG_RUN carry.
